content: go:embed directive embeds files at compile time. For a single file use //go:embed data/quotes.json followed by var quotesData []byte (or string). For a directory tree use embed.FS: var content embed.FS then content.ReadFile("data/quotes.json"). Pattern rules: forward slashes only, files starting with . or _ excluded by default. The embed.FS type implements io/fs.FS with Open, ReadFile, ReadDir. Single-file []byte embedding is simplest for a known JSON file path.
